note: Which stock-system location each bay holds. Codes are AREA-BAY (just AREA where the bay isn't known) as in the stock list (AAA-01 is the start of AAA-01-12-06). Bay 1 is nearest the middle aisle. Only location codes live here, never stock. Built from detailedfoil's descriptions on 29 Oct 2026. `areas` gives each stock area's number of shelves and positions a shelf (seen in the stock list). The AA_ areas have `drawers` shelves of cardboard drawers, 15.3 cm apart (`pitch`, shelf 10 about chin height), with `drawerPositions` positions a drawer shelf (2 a drawer, 4 in a half width bay); `positions` is then for the shelves above. `bays` changes an area's settings for one bay (AAC 5 and 6 have 12 positions a drawer shelf, so wider drawers). `faces` says which side of a bay open both ways each area is on (S = shop side). `ignore` lists areas (HAD) or bays (LAC-05) left off the plan, detailedfoil's say. `notFree` lists shelves (AREA-BAY-SHELF, or a whole bay or area) left empty on purpose, so they never count as free spots: BAA 1-4 shelves 6 and 7 are there but kept empty (detailedfoil, 30 Oct 2026); BBC 9 and BBG 9 are floor spots with no fixed positions. `ignore` can also hold a bay (HAA-01 and HAB-01 are left off the plan, detailedfoil 30 Oct). `areas` came from the full 10,999 product list on 30 Oct 2026.
